in_marathi.name: Charitra
in_marathi.long_meaning: Charitra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'charitra' meaning a story or history. This name signifies the richness of one's past and the significance of sharing it with others. It is also associated with the goddess Lakshmi, who represents wealth, fortune, and prosperity.
